newsitem.title: USA: Falcon Building, Investcorp complete merger.
newsitem.headline: Falcon Building, Investcorp complete merger.

text.p: Falcon Building Products Inc and Investcorp said on Tuesday they had merged in a transaction valued at roughly $585 million.
Under the merger agreement, Investcorp, an international investment group, along with some international investors will own about 88 percent of the equity of Falcon.
The remaining 12 percent will be held by existing shareholders, the companies said in a joint statement.
As a result of the merger, Falcon said it expected to be delisted from the New York Stock Exchange "as soon as practicable."

At the announced price per share of $17.75, the merger was valued at about $585 million, a decrease of $5 million from the estimated value on March 20 when the companies announced a definitive agreement to merge.
Falcon is a manufacturer of building products serving residential and consumer markets.
